needs.semantics: Craft is an activated ability of the permanent: pay the mana, exile the permanent itself, and exile EITHER a matching permanent you control OR a matching card from your graveyard; the card then returns to the battlefield transformed under its owner's control, sorcery speed only. The return half is already expressible (transform to:'back' asItEnters, then move to battlefield) and exileSelf already pays the self-exile; what is missing is a cost part that exiles a permanent you control and a cost part that offers a choice between two payment shapes.
